summary: Batch 023 completed the mandatory 0.2.1 release closure. Both public 0.2.1 packages were re-verified unchanged/latest and were never republished. Interactive npm security-key flows successfully deprecated exactly @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.0 first and then dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0; both remain published with clear upgrade-to-0.2.1 guidance. The existing v0.2.1 annotated tag and public GitHub Release resolve exactly to accepted product commit 2ea15a0f7a676dbf073b0b5bdbd90c15b1df4281. The real Harness web profile remains on dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.1 active with @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.1 present through official lifecycle tooling; composition, host boot, settings, catalog and rendered plugin-client smoke passed. The optional hosted-provider UI smoke reached image upload and understand_image but no normal assistant reply arrived within 180 seconds, so it is PARTIAL and explicitly non-blocking. No secret material was inspected or recorded, ACTIVE_TASK.json was deleted, and PR #65 remains Draft/unmerged.

These exact public tarball identities match the accepted prior byte-level candidate evidence. No publish was run.

tests.name: npm-authentication-and-secret-safety
tests.evidence: npm ping returned PONG and npm whoami returned public account name rss1001. Because the account uses a WebAuthn security key rather than TOTP, each authorized write ran in an interactive TTY: npm generated its official authentication page, ENTER opened the browser, and the user completed the security-key ceremony directly. No password, PIN, OTP, token, cookie, authorization header, auth response, npm config or debug-log content was read or recorded.

tests.name: service-0.2.0-deprecation
tests.evidence: Executed exactly npm deprecate @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.0 with the authorized defective-missing-built-lib guidance through npm's official interactive security-key flow; exit 0. Immediate prefer-online registry verification confirmed deprecated='0.2.0 is defective because the published package is missing built lib/** artifacts. Upgrade to 0.2.1.' The version remains published.

tests.name: plugin-0.2.0-deprecation

Immediate prefer-online registry verification confirmed the exact deprecated field. The version remains published.

Only boolean and HTTP evidence was recorded. The task-owned host was stopped and its port verified closed; the plugin remained installed.

tests.name: final-registry-and-release-state
tests.evidence: Final prefer-online verification confirmed both 0.2.1 versions remain public/latest and complete; exactly both 0.2.0 versions remain published with the intended deprecated guidance; version lists and dist-tags contain no unexpected changes. v0.2.1 and its GitHub Release remain tied to the accepted product commit. No republish, unpublish, access, visibility or arbitrary dist-tag mutation occurred.

notes: ACTIVE_TASK.json was deleted because all mandatory acceptance criteria completed successfully.
